dz: 教宗英诺森特二世颁发了最佳公牛"奥姆内"(Omne datum),他在其中认可了圣殿骑士并批准了圣殿统治.

te: Roger II of Sicily is excommunicated by Innocent II for supporting Anacletus II as pope for seven years, even though Ro…
dz: 西西里州的罗杰二世因支持安纳克图斯二世为教皇7年而被英诺森二世驱出,尽管罗杰已经公开承认了英诺森对教宗的主张.
de: Roger II of Sicily is excommunicated by Innocent II for supporting Anacletus II as pope for seven years, even though Roger had already publicly recognized Innocent's claim to the papacy.

t: 由阿里·伊本·优素福领导的阿尔莫拉维德人被被宣布为葡萄牙国王的阿丰索·恩里克斯亲王所击败.
te: The Almoravids, led by Ali ibn Yusuf, are defeated by Prince Afonso Henriques who is proclaimed King of Portugal.
dz: 乌里克之战:由阿里·伊本·优素福领导的阿尔莫拉维德人被被宣布为葡萄牙国王的阿丰索·恩里克斯亲王所击败.
de: Battle of Ourique: The Almoravids, led by Ali ibn Yusuf, are defeated by Prince Afonso Henriques who is proclaimed King of Portugal.

dz: 教宗英诺森二世在"米尼亚诺条约"中确认将西西里的罗杰二世之子们交给他们的领地,并放弃对反对罗杰的男爵的支持.
de: Pope Innocent II confirms in the treaty of Mignano the investiture of the sons of Roger II of Sicily to their fiefs and abandons support for the barons opposed to Roger.
